name: AscendAntiQuant
note: adv_api anti-quantization. AscendAntiQuant<InT,OutT,isTranspose>(dst<OutT>,src<InT>,offset,scale,sharedTmpBuffer<uint8>,K,shapeInfo); scalar offset/scale are OutputType. Formula dst=scale*(src+offset) (offset ADDED then scaled, per impl). Non-transpose processes src.GetSize(); K only used by transpose path.
